name: Brigade Whitefield-Kadugodi Integrated Township
tagline: East Bengaluru's mega destination is rising
overview: Brigade's grandest integrated township — a 40-acre destination on Whitefield-Kadugodi Main Road inspired by Renaissance design, bringing together homes, retail, hospitality, workplaces and leisure in one planned ecosystem. Premium 1, 2, 3 & 4 BHK residences are designed for complete living, backed by Brigade's four-decade legacy as masters of integrated townships.
highlights: 40-acre integrated township on Whitefield-Kadugodi Main Road
Homes, retail, hospitality, workplaces and leisure within one ecosystem
~2.39 lakh+ sq.ft retail built-up area, ~4.49 lakh+ sq.ft commercial built-up area, ~251 hotel keys planned
15 minutes to K R Puram, 30 minutes to ITPL and ORR, 35 minutes to Kempegowda International Airport
Positioned amid East Bengaluru's Technology Corridor: ITPL, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Mahadevapura
Multi-speciality hospital planned within the township
By Brigade Group — 40 years of legacy, 300+ projects, 90 million sq.ft delivered

locationInfo.summary: Positioned amid East Bengaluru's thriving employment hubs on Whitefield-Kadugodi Main Road, within the East Bengaluru Technology Corridor and North-East Innovation & Business Corridor.
